summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Real-Time Violation Alerts and Batch Court-Grade Analysis features. All 28 tests passed (100%). Real-Time Alerts correctly detects 6 violation types with 38 keywords total. Severity mapping verified: critical (excessive_force), high (miranda, unlawful_search, first_amendment, racial_profiling), medium (detention). Escalation detection working separately from keyword matching. Batch Analysis endpoints working with proper limits enforced.
